title: Demo: dependency conflict + classifier dimension + wrong normalisation
goal: Reproduce the documented experiment and determine why the validation accuracy does not match the documented result. Fix the repository so it reproduces the documented result.

ground_truth.description: Three independent faults that surface one after another: install error, crash, then a wrong metric.

stages.statement: requirements.txt pins numpy==2.1.0 and numpy<2 at once, so installation fails.
The output layer W2 is allocated with hidden//2 inputs, so the classifier dimension does not match the hidden layer.
Inputs are normalised with generic mean 0.5/std 0.5 instead of the documented dataset statistics.
